title: Serve product manuals
description: Product pages link to PDF manuals. Adds `manuals/` for the PDFs, with the first one, and GET /api/manuals?file= to serve them. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: `file` comes from the query string and is joined to the folder unchecked, so `?file=../../somewhere/secret.pdf` (or an absolute path) reads any PDF the server can reach: path traversal. Allow only plain file names, or check the resolved path stays inside `manuals/`.
